claim: Tests whether Virelai derives floor and wall hypotheses from observed ego exchange and refused full-footprint landings, uses the resulting action-space map to approach each target, and requires a target-conditioned falsifier before a provisional unreachable conclusion.
claim_limits: This checkpoint does not grade competition score, level completion, G4 closure, or a win.
UNREACHABLE_IN_CURRENT_WORLD_STATE is provisional and must reopen after a relevant world or routing change.
Duck may explain a semantic boundary but may not select a controller-computable environment action.
Human review of lossless artifacts is required before claiming behavioral success.

inference_profile.purpose: bounded G3 NAV terrain/reachability checkpoint; not a score run

infrastructure_criteria: I0: the shipped source holds no tools/live_level_carry_gate.py and no world name in the solver's executable code other than the harness's public game roster (packager guard).
I1: G0 assigns NAVIGATION from metadata, and the controller executor is on (probe envelopes carry executor CONTROLLER and the protocol stamp g3_inherits_g2_nulls true).
I2: the downloaded execution receipt is byte-identical to the package receipt.
I3: the run writes the memory artifacts: turn ledger, gate answers with executor, probe envelopes, control-map evidence, and contact epochs where reached.
I4: approach and contact remain distinct in recorded evidence and only contact can advance G4.
live_criteria: C0: G0-G2 repeat the already-proven controller-owned closure and install the complete counter mask.
C1: G3 reports floor integer 3 from direct G1 ego/ground exchange evidence.
C2: a uniform refused full-footprint landing reports wall integer 4.
C3: the interacted floor and wall components are typed in the target ledger with evidence refs.
C4: the configuration map uses the demonstrated 5x5 ego footprint and learned action vectors.
C5: predicted reachable targets receive controller-owned route/contact actions.
C6: predicted unreachable targets receive a target-conditioned falsifier before any verdict.
C7: a yielding falsifier expands routing; a refused falsifier may open a provisional explanation.
C8: approach-time target changes do not advance incomplete rows; scoped-null contacts close immediately.
C9: relevant world deltas invalidate terrain/refusal conclusions and reopen affected rows.
C10: every controller-computable environment action remains controller-owned.
C11: the run ends at completion or the explicit 64-action/900-second safety cap without crashing.
precondition: Gate criteria are graded only when the run reaches that gate; a stall earlier leaves them ungraded, not failed. All measurements come from artifact state (turn ledger, gate events, gate answers, probe envelopes, annotations), not from prose.
revisions: G3 NAV integer terrain and reachability at f985410
source_delivery: Kaggle may mount src/ directly or transport it as src.zip; the notebook verifies extracted files before imports.
